operations.name: List Containers
operations.notes: Lists active containers; deleted containers and container metadata options are unavailable.

operations.name: Create Container
operations.notes: Creates private containers without service-managed encryption or immutability options.

operations.name: Get Container Properties
operations.notes: Returns ETag and Last-Modified; does not report Azure retention or replication properties.

operations.name: Delete Container
operations.notes: Deletes local data without soft deletion.

operations.name: List Blobs (flat)
operations.notes: Supports prefix, marker, maxresults, and metadata. No delimiter or version listings.

operations.name: Put Blob (BlockBlob)
operations.notes: Supports block blobs with local upload limits and a subset of Azure write headers.

operations.name: Put Block
operations.notes: Staged blocks have local size limits and do not expire on Azure's schedule.

operations.name: Put Block List
operations.notes: Commits an ordered block list with local size limits and a subset of Azure write headers.

operations.name: Get Block List
operations.notes: Reports staged and committed blocks for the current blob, not snapshots or versions.

operations.name: Get Blob
operations.notes: Reads the current blob or a single byte range with ETag conditions.

operations.name: Get Blob Properties
operations.notes: Reports current content properties and metadata; no snapshot or version selection.

operations.name: Delete Blob
operations.notes: Deletes the current blob without retention or snapshot handling.
